diagnosis: The search already allocates more than 99% of visits to waiting; the final no-op mask removes Snore due to type immunity. The active Destiny Bond exception is absent at these decision boundaries because the faster opponent has not yet reapplied it.
limits: The position was designed, not discovered in a recorded competitive game; natural prevalence is unmeasured.
This proves suboptimal action selection in the current engine on this position, not a general inability to plan combos.

The proof compares the bot action upper bound with an explicit multi-turn waiting policy lower bound. Forcing only the first Snore and then returning control to the unchanged bot is not the winning policy.
Live continuations use one battle seed; the universal claim comes from exhaustive engine branching, not those four demonstrations.
The bounded verifier is an offline diagnostic. No search algorithm, rollout, evaluation weights, or bot policy was changed for this finding.
construction_audit: An initial Misdreavus/Night Shade draft failed the learnset check and was discarded.
A reduced two-move opponent draft was replaced with four publicly revealed moves and all selected party members revealed.

The final proof includes every legal Magikarp move; an un-memoized diagnostic hit its 100000-run cap, so repeated states are shared by state_key128 plus remaining depth. The same work cap is retained.
